title: The Man Who Was Betrayed by the Sea
notes: Recurring detective-cast (Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko -- the 'Detective Boys') omitted by convention, matching the old cases/ file's note. No `event` node type: the murder is decomposed into direct verb edges (deceives, drowns) plus provenance edges for the density-tampering method. The old lower-fidelity case file was broadly correct on the culprit (Nao Takiguchi) and mechanism (raised pool-water density via bath salt then water-soluble polymer to fake a swimming ability), but it collapsed the two real locations (the residence pool where the fraud was staged, and the open sea where the drowning actually happened) into one 'Ocean / yacht pool' node, omitted Ryouichi Katagiri and Detective Nagai as nodes entirely despite both driving the on-screen investigation, omitted the necklace-buoyancy clue (the actual clinching piece of evidence Conan uses -- the collar-rust detail alone was never confirmed on screen as evidence found by police, it's what tips off Conan's reasoning, not what he presents), and omitted Katagiri's on-screen suggestion that Nao married for money, which functions as an in-story (unconfirmed) alternate motive theory. Per the broadened was_at rule, every named person shown present in a scene (Nao, Kotaro, Katagiri, Nagai) gets was_at edges. Temporal/order fields intentionally omitted per current build rules. case_type: murder.
